figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 1. Typical catalytic process of three-component P450s system for
hydroxylation reactions. FAD, ﬂavin adenine dinucleotide; FeS, a small
iron sulfur cluster. The structure of FdR (CamA) was shown in cyan
(PDB: 1Q1R), the structure of Fdx (CamB) was shown in green (PDB:
1OQQ), and the structure of OleP was shown in pink (PDB: 4XE3).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 2. Screening for the most appropriate redox partner for OleP. a) Evaluation of the OleP-Fdx or OleP-Fld complex structures. Complex
structures were simulated by Alphafold2-multimer. Å represents the distance between FeS or FMN and heme-Fe. b) Visualization of ﬁve OleP-Fdx or
OleP-Fld complex structures. OleP is depicted in green, whereas Fdx or Fld is shown in cyan. Heme, FeS, and ﬂavin mononucleotide are illustrated as
red sticks, orange sticks, and rainbow sticks, respectively. c) Fluorescent intensities and conversion rates of LCA for E. coli F0–F4 and E. coli C0–C4
strains. The blue triangle denotes ﬂuorescent intensity/OD600, whereas the red triangle represents the conversion rate (%). Values and triangles
indicate the means and standard deviations of biological triplicates. d) Presentation of colors and ﬂuorescent images for E. coli F0–F4 strains.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 3. Development of HTS method for LCA and MDCA. a) Identiﬁcation of specialized chemical agents capable of interacting with MDCA. b)
Selection of the special wavelength for MDCA detection. c) Standard curve correlating the concentration of MDCA with the absorption values in
370 nm. Higher the concentration of MDCA, more the yellow color of the reaction solutions. d) Validation of devised HTS method by comparing with
HPLC method.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 4. Semirational design of PetF. a) Alignment of structures between PetF and Fd I. b) Alignment of amino acid sequences between PetF and Fd
I. Protein–protein interaction regions (PPIR) on the surface of PetF were denoted by cyan underlines. c) ࢞࢞G values for alanine scanning mutations
compared to PetFwild-type. d) ࢞࢞G values for saturation mutations at 7 key residues compared to PetFwild-type. e) NADH coupling eﬃciency and total
turnover number of P450 enzyme OleP catalytic system. f) Assessment of ﬂuorescent intensities and catalytic activities of designed variants. Blue
columns represent the ﬂuorescent intensity/OD600, whereas the red columns indicate the conversion rate of LCA to MDCA (%).
